title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: A composite photo of a largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) before PIT tagging, and juvenile rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) under near-infrared light. Credit: Jessica Frey

This image was provided by the authors of Prey group cohesion mediates the outcome of predator–prey interactions under artificial lighting (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70389), which features in this issue. They evaluated potential associations between light treatment, prey group cohesion and predator activity, finding that across all light treatments, the less cohesive the prey groups were, the higher the probability that interested predators would attack.

This issue also features the Special Feature Large Scale, Open Data, and a Big Tent: Leveraging collaboration, transparency, and inclusion to advance macrosystems biology, which aims to address the challenges of conducting ecological science at large spatial scales, producing novel research and approaches that advance the field of macrosystems biology.
